literal: Target body to suffering knowing that, trouble as helplessness will not consider indeed the great.
translation: Knowing that the body is a natural target for suffering, great people will not consider trouble as a state of helplessness.
modern: உடம்பு துன்பத்திற்கு ஓர் இலக்கு என்பதை உணர்ந்து, சிறந்த மனிதர்கள் தமக்கு வரும் துன்பத்தைக் கண்டு கலங்கிச் செயலற்றுப் போக மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains the mindset of great people when facing adversity. They understand that the physical body is naturally a target for pain and suffering. Because they accept this fundamental truth, they do not view sudden troubles as a source of helpless confusion. Instead, they remain steadfast and unfaltering in the face of hardship.
